action_items: (Editorial polish, LOW) The empty-state badge reads 'Vuoto' (full word) — request spec says 'VUOTO' (uppercase). Currently EMF renders with title-case Italian labels (Vuoto/Caricamento/Pronto/Da library/URL esterno/Errore). If the canon vocabulary is uppercase, update EMPTY_STATES mapping in EditorialMediaField.jsx accordingly. Cosmetic only.

(Documentation, LOW) Review request references `data-testid='ss-band-hero'` but actual section_type is 'store_hero' (testid: ss-band-store_hero). Update spec doc or rename section_type for clarity — not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: EditorialMediaField.jsx is 520 lines — manageable but trending toward split. As locale-aware crop preset hints (logo/hero/gallery/square/portrait/story/thumbnail) grow, consider extracting EMFEmptyState / EMFReadyState / EMFExternalInput sub-components.

AddReferenceModal.jsx submit handler swallows the editorial-interpretation latency silently — only shows generic toast 'Riferimento aggiunto · interpretazione editoriale in corso'. Consider surfacing editorial_status=queued/interpreting in the references list with a spinner so curators understand the async pipeline.

POST /api/references requires imported_image_url even when source_type='pinterest' (modal works around this by reusing pinUrl). When real Pinterest scraping is wired, ensure the contract accepts source_url-only for pinterest type and lets the backend resolve imported_image_url asynchronously.

EditorialMediaField applies tenant-prefix via /api/storage/signed-upload (verified: path becomes <tenant_uuid>/brand/logo/test.png). Good. No path-traversal sanitization visible in storage.py — verify backend strips leading '/' or '..' segments to prevent escaping tenant prefix.
ReferencesPage.jsx uses primaryRef for action button testid (cta-${act.replace('_', '-')}-${reference.id}) — for IDs containing hyphens this becomes ambiguous. Prefer cta-<verb>__<id>.

Modal close button is below the fold at 1440x900 with full metadata form — element 'outside viewport' caused a Playwright click failure. Add sticky header/footer to the modal so close + submit are always reachable without scrolling.
